abstract: Maintains structural engineering certifications and mechanical floor load ratings
system_message:
You are the Facilities engineering lead (FAC). Your responsibilities include maintaining structural engineering certifications and mechanical floor load ratings across candidate convention venues, as well as tracking ventilation monitoring metrics.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ventilation monitoring（HVAC）
information_points.content:
FAC-HVAC-24Z：Environmental airflow monitoring shows that Meridian Waterfront Convention Centre maintains an air exchange rate of 8 ACH across the main exhibition and conference halls during operational hours.
FAC-HVAC-8HX：At Olympus Grand Forum Complex, environmental airflow monitoring records an air exchange rate of 6 ACH across the main exhibition and conference halls during operational hours.
FAC-HVAC-UFH：At Starlight Exhibition and Congress Park, environmental airflow assessments record an air exchange rate of 12 ACH across the main exhibition and conference halls during operational hours.

information_points.title: Maintains structural engineering certifications and mechanical floor load ratings（STRUCT）
information_points.content:
FAC-STRUCT-Q54：For the Starlight Exhibition and Congress Park, structural inspection confirms that the main plenary exhibition hall slab has its structural floor load certified for supporting at least 20 kN/m2 of live heavy equipment loading.
FAC-STRUCT-WG9：For the Olympus Grand Forum Complex, the civil engineering structural inspection report indicates that the main plenary exhibition hall slab is not structural floor load certified for supporting at least 20 kN/m2 live heavy equipment loading.
FAC-STRUCT-MK4：For the Meridian Waterfront Convention Centre, the main plenary exhibition hall slab is verified under structural engineering inspection to have its structural floor load certified, validating live heavy equipment loading of at least 20 kN/m2.
